issues.issue: Mixed line: Sanitary Landfill refuse charges 303,080 (64%) plus recreation, cemetery, community center, fire contract and other charges (p5, p14, p19-22, p28-29, p31). Dominant-category choice is defensible; the line also holds Recreation Fees, Cemetery Fees and charges for services.

Includes Grant Project Fund 'Grant income' 414,359 (p32), shown as operating grants for economic development on p2; the grantor is not stated and it may be a government (state/federal) grant rather than a private donation.
'Maintenance and operation' reads as a combined operating function line rather than a pure repairs cost type; could be utilities.
Printed 'Community development' only (not 'development/betterment'); Community Betterment vs economic development is a judgment call.

Electric Fund budgetary receipts are mostly lease agreement income 246,399 and interest 86,583 (p9); electric charges for services were only 4,501. Category Utility Charges/electric charges overstates utility sales.

Sched 28 (p34) shows the Electric Fund's 157,156 budgetary disbursement is entirely the change in due to/due from other funds (interfund advance), with accrual expenses 86,133 being depreciation only; recorded as utilities spending, which is questionable.
